description: This Dart source file defines the 'FirebaseMessagingService' class, a utility for handling Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) operations such as initialization, permission requests, and obtaining device tokens within a Flutter project.

classes.name: FirebaseMessagingService
classes.description: Helper utility class for managing Firebase Cloud Messaging operations such as initialization, requesting permissions, and retrieving device tokens.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes Firebase if it hasn't been initialized already.

methods.name: requestPermission
methods.description: Requests notification permissions from the user (primarily on iOS).

methods.description: Fetches the current FCM registration token for the device.
